scenario.name: lidar_dropout
scenario.description: The lidar stops delivering scans while the robot drives to its second stop.

ground_truth.summary: No lidar scans reach Nav2; costmaps and localization stop updating and the collision monitor has no data.

alerts: the supervisor is holding after a failed goal: Navigation failed on the way to PICK_B; holding for recovery before the retry
scans stopped arriving at about 20.0 s and never resumed (normal rate 5.0 Hz)

actions.why: this process was seen dead or silent

diagnosis.root_cause: The lidar stopped delivering scans at approximately 20.0 s, causing the costmap to become stale. This led to controller_server errors at 21.6 s where it attempted to transform a goal pose using outdated or extrapolated data, resulting in the navigation failure at PICK_B.
evidence: lidar scans stopped arriving at about 20.0 s and never resumed
controller_server ERROR from 21.6 s: Lookup would require extrapolation into the future
controller_server ERROR from 21.6 s: Unable to transform goal pose into costmap frame

decision.note: The diagnosis indicates the lidar stopped delivering scans (sensor_dropout), causing stale costmaps and controller_server errors. Restarting the lidar_driver should restore scan data, allowing the costmap to update and the navigation stack to recover.

incidents.settled: scans at 3.7 Hz and every heartbeat present, 6 s after the fix
